release_slices.name: POS DGFY cashier account search hotfix
release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Restore registered DGFY account search and selection in the POS cashier invitation dialog so an invitation can be submitted.
release_slices.purpose: Restore registered DGFY account search and selection in the POS cashier invitation dialog so an invitation can be submitted.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Always render the existing registered DGFY account search when the invitation caller fixes the role to cashier. The fixed cashier role, selected-account requirement, tenant-scoped API, payload, and location grants stay unchanged. This manifest records the exact reviewed production candidate.
included_features: Registered DGFY account search in fixed-role cashier invitations
Account selection and exact cashier invitation payload regression coverage
Governed release evidence for the hotfix
excluded_features: Backend DGFY API, tenant membership, authentication, authorization, database, payment, or fiscal changes
Checkout, Storefront, shift-open, terminal-pairing, and unrelated dirty-worktree changes
release_slices.owner_attribution: BabyBaBab owner-authorized hotfix and production deployment
release_slices.regression_warning_summary: The shared invitation modal changes fixed-role rendering. A regression could break account selection in POS cashier invitations or disturb other invitation entry points.
potentially_affected_existing_behaviors: POS cashier invitation account search and selection
evidence_covering_regression_risk: Three focused frontend test files and 25 tests passed, including fixedRole cashier search, selection, and exact payload.
SKUpervisor and POS production builds passed.
Architecture, controller-boundary, compliance/API-contract, and whitespace checks passed.
Local POS shell loaded without console errors; authentication prevented uncredentialed mutation.
evidence_gaps: The authenticated modal could not be rendered locally because the clean environment has no seeded operator credentials.
Post-deploy smoke must confirm the live tenant search without sending an unintended invitation.
rollback_or_monitoring_notes: Revert the hotfix and release-manifest commits, then deploy the revert through the signed controller.
Monitor DGFY search 400/429/500 responses and POS invitation validation errors.

completed_tests.evidence: Clean release worktree: 3 files and 25 tests passed.

documentation_closure.rationale: ADR 0031 already defines POS setup using DGFY account search with a fixed cashier role. This release manifest documents the restored behavior, risk, evidence, rollback, and production proof without changing architecture or API contracts.

documents.evidence: Records exact scope, regression warning, validation, rollback, and production accuracy requirements.
Already requires DGFY account search and invitation with fixed cashier role during POS setup.
Normal exact-SHA signed-controller flow remains applicable.

release_slices.adr_or_compliance: No new ADR or compliance declaration is required because the fix restores ADR 0031 behavior and changes no backend authorization, fiscal, payment, or data contract.
release_slices.rollback_notes: Revert the hotfix and manifest commits, rerun focused tests, builds, governance gates, and deploy the revert through the signed controller.
production_proof_required: Production remote HEAD, deploy state, deploy summary, runtime health SHA, and frontend assets equal promoted master
Live POS cashier invitation visibly exposes DGFY account search with fixed cashier role
Controlled search can select an eligible account and enable submission when a location is selected
production_accuracy_checks_required: Deployed UserInvitationModal renders search outside the non-fixed-role conditional
Deployed test source contains fixedRole cashier search and exact payload regression case
Live search returns eligible accounts or a truthful tenant/rate-limit response without an unintended invitation
Non-fixed-role invitation entry points retain role selector and account picker
